# Mutation control

<!-- Generated by scripts/run_mutation_control.py; do not edit by hand. -->

First-order mutants of the 71 fixed reference ports in the contract benchmark, each verified under the unchanged contract. A killed mutant is refuted, a surviving one is proven, an invalid one verifies neither way. Score = killed / (killed + survived).

A survivor is either a behaviour the contract does not pin down or an equivalent mutant. The benchmark contracts state one requirement each, so survivors in unrelated parts of a body are expected; they show how much of the body a contract constrains, not a defect in the benchmark.
